chapter_title_en: The One Who Claims My Name
chapter_seo_title: Doppelgänger Returns: Xiao Chen's Clone Challenges the Mortal World
chapter_meta_description: A doppelgänger of Xiao Chen reappears atop a colossal stone statue, defeating Nine-Headed Serpent and Ye Jiu, and declares he will marry Empress Zhao Lin'er. The real Xiao Chen watches in a purple skeletal form.
